shared_hard_findings.finding: Both judgments make a material direction or trend claim about company operating or gross margin, but the selected NumericFacts bind current Q1 FY2027 against FY2026 full year rather than a same-cadence prior quarter. The reviewed source excerpt contains prior-quarter figures, so the business direction may be true, but the submitted relation has no deterministic comparable-period formula trace. Current validation proves referenced facts exist; it does not prove the narrative relation used compatible periods.
shared_hard_findings.required_disposition: Expose prior comparable-quarter NumericFacts or a deterministic same-cadence relation fact, require a typed relation/direction binding for comparative language, and reject Q1-versus-FY trend narration before rendering.
